scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @text-to-cad/core && npm run build -w @text-to-cad/ui
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @text-to-cad/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @text-to-cad/desktop
scripts.build:docs: npm run build -w @text-to-cad/core && npm run build -w cad-skills-docs
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @text-to-cad/web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run native:rebuild -w @text-to-cad/desktop && npm run dev -w @text-to-cad/desktop
scripts.dev:docs: npm run build -w @text-to-cad/core && npm run dev -w cad-skills-docs
